description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア』に登場する量産型MSジェガンがMG化！
description.en: The mass-produced MS Jegan that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack" is now an MG!

description.ja: • 『逆襲のシャア』に登場したシルエットバランスを踏襲し、ずっしりと安定感のあるジェガンを再現！
description.en: • Following the silhouette balance that appeared in "Char's Counterattack", we reproduce the heavy and stable Jegan!

description.ja: • 完全新規造形のMS内部フレームが採用され、量産機を象徴する内部骨格を組み立てるだけで再現できる！
description.en: • A completely newly shaped MS internal frame is adopted, allowing you to reproduce the internal skeleton that symbolizes mass-produced machines just by using Assembly!

description.ja: • 左右4種類ずつのハンドパーツが付属し、ライフルを構えるポーズからアクシズに取りつく名シーンまで再現可能！
description.en: • Four types of hand parts on the left and right sides are included, allowing you to recreate everything from the pose of holding a rifle to the famous scene of him clinging to Axis!
